authentication: Google Cloud service account / OAuth2 inside a GCP project (billing account needed only beyond the free query tier)
cost_notes: First 1 TB of query data per month free; beyond that on-demand BigQuery pricing applies (the per-TB price was not captured from the pricing page this round). Requires a GCP project + OAuth.
free_tier: first 1 TB of query data per month is free (stated on the public-data page) and billing is only needed beyond that; a GCP project + OAuth credentials are nevertheless mandatory
historical_coverage: worldwide publications, very deep (19th century onward for major offices)
known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09: bigquery.googleapis.com returned HTTP 401 for anonymous reads; the marketplace listing is public but the data is not.
Requires a Google Cloud project and OAuth credentials even to use the free 1 TB/month allowance; a billing account is needed only to exceed it. Both are outside this round's rules.
Cost control is a real hazard: an unfiltered query over patents.publications scans tens of TB and would consume months of free allowance in one statement; partition/cluster filters are mandatory.
This is the best available source for family_id plus pre-grant publications plus citations, so it is the natural upgrade path if MedRadar ever gets a GCP project.
The old documentation URL https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/public-data/google-patents now 404s; the live entry points are the marketplace listing and the BigQuery public-data index.
licence: Google Patents Public Datasets terms; underlying documents come from many offices with varying terms, attribution required
rate_limits: BigQuery quotas; on-demand pricing after the free tier
research_value: The richest patent corpus with family ids and pre-grant publications, and it would let MedRadar compute true public-visibility cohorts across offices. But 'free' here means a 1 TB/month query allowance, not free access: it needs a billing-enabled GCP project, so it is a procurement decision, not a download.
source_name: Google Patents Public Data (BigQuery public dataset)
